description: Repo-scale (terraform-webapp): redirecting HTTP to HTTPS on the ALB listener needs the ALB security group to actually allow port 443 ingress too
prompts: Change the HTTP listener in alb.tf (`aws_lb_listener.http`) so its `default_action` redirects instead of forwarding: `type = "redirect"` with a `redirect` block sending clients to port 443, protocol HTTPS, status_code HTTP_301. This alone isn't enough - the ALB's own security group (`aws_security_group.alb` in security_groups.tf) currently only allows inbound port 80. Add a matching ingress rule allowing port 443 too, otherwise every client gets redirected to a port the load balancer itself rejects, breaking all traffic.

test_setup_files.check_https_redirect.py:
import json
import re
import subprocess

init = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'init', '-backend=false', '-input=false'],
                      capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
assert init.returncode == 0, f'terraform init failed:\n{init.stdout}\n{init.stderr}'

validate = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'validate', '-no-color', '-json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
data = json.loads(validate.stdout)
assert data.get('valid') is True, f'terraform validate failed: {validate.stdout}\n{validate.stderr}'

alb = open('alb.tf', encoding='utf-8').read()
listener = re.search(r'resource\s+"aws_lb_listener"\s+"http"\s*\{(.*?)\n\}\s*$', alb, re.DOTALL)
assert listener, 'aws_lb_listener.http not found'
block = listener.group(1)
assert re.search(r'type\s*=\s*"redirect"', block), 'listener default_action must redirect to HTTPS'
assert re.search(r'port\s*=\s*"443"', block), 'redirect must target port 443'

sg = open('security_groups.tf', encoding='utf-8').read()
alb_sg_match = re.search(r'resource\s+"aws_security_group"\s+"alb"\s*\{(.*?)\n\}\s*\n\n', sg, re.DOTALL)
assert alb_sg_match, 'aws_security_group.alb not found'
alb_sg_block = alb_sg_match.group(1)
assert re.search(r'ingress\s*\{[^}]*from_port\s*=\s*443', alb_sg_block, re.DOTALL), (
    'aws_security_group.alb is missing a 443 ingress rule - the listener now redirects every '
    'client to HTTPS, but the load balancer itself would reject the resulting inbound 443 '
    'connections, breaking every request')

print('PASS')
